gloss.en: A monastery or convent governed by an abbot or abbess; also its buildings or church
gloss.zh-Hans: 由男修道院院长或女修道院院长主持的修道院，也可指其建筑或教堂

meaning.en: The primary Chinese lexical equivalent is 修道院. 比, 笔 and 蓓 are not standard translations.
meaning.zh-Hans: 主要汉语词义对应是“修道院”；“比”“笔”“蓓”都不是标准翻译。

rationale.en: Authoritative English and French dictionaries define the word as a monastic institution. The Chinese target records that ordinary lexical meaning; sound and literary candidates remain separate observations.
rationale.zh-Hans: 权威英语、法语词典均把该词定义为修道制度中的机构。汉语目标记录普通词义对应；声音候选与文学候选另轨保存。

summary.en: English abbey came through Middle English and Anglo-French from Medieval Latin abbātia. The base title abbās/abbot ultimately reflects Aramaic abba ‘father’ through ecclesiastical Greek and Christian Latin. This supports an indirect historical connection to Abba, not a direct borrowing from a modern Jewish form and not a relation to Chinese bi/bei.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 abbey 经中古英语和盎格鲁-法语进入，来源是中世纪拉丁语 abbātia。其基础称谓 abbās／abbot 又经教会希腊语和基督教拉丁语上溯至阿拉米语 abba“父亲”。这说明它与 Abba 有间接的深层词史联系，并非直接借自某个现代犹太教形式，也不证明与汉语 bi／bei 有历史关系。

claim.en: Middle English abbeye/abbay was borrowed from Anglo-French abeie/abbaye, from Medieval Latin abbātia.
claim.zh-Hans: 中古英语 abbeye／abbay 借自盎格鲁-法语 abeie／abbaye，后者来自中世纪拉丁语 abbātia。

claim.en: French abbé comes from Christian Latin abbās, transmitted through ecclesiastical Greek from Aramaic abba ‘father’; abbaye is derived from that abbatial title through Latin abbātia.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbé 来自基督教拉丁语 abbās；该称谓经教会希腊语源自阿拉米语 abba“父亲”。abbaye 则经拉丁语 abbātia 从这一院长称谓派生。

claim.en: French abbesse is borrowed from Christian Latin abbatissa, a derivative of abbas, and names the female head of an abbey.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbesse 借自基督教拉丁语 abbatissa，是 abbas 的派生词，指女修道院院长。

summary.en: Modern abbey /ˈæbi/ has a surface-final resemblance to Mandarin bǐ /pi/; French abbaye /a.be.i/ and abbé /a.be/ can also sound loosely similar to bi/bei. These are non-systematic modern-form resemblances. 比 and 笔 lack the required lexical meaning; 蓓 gains relevance only through a literary metaphor.
summary.zh-Hans: 现代英语 abbey /ˈæbi/ 的词尾与普通话 bǐ /pi/ 有表面近似；法语 abbaye /a.be.i/、abbé /a.be/ 与 bi／bei 也可能产生宽泛听感近似。这些都不是系统音变。“比”“笔”缺少所需词义，“蓓”只通过文学隐喻获得关联。

claim.en: abbey-final /bi/ and 比/笔 bǐ /pi/ share a high front vowel and a labial stop, but differ in voicing/phonological system, syllable position and Mandarin tone.
claim.zh-Hans: abbey 词尾 /bi/ 与“比／笔”bǐ /pi/ 共享高前元音与唇塞音，但在浊音／音系、音节位置及普通话声调上不同。

claim.en: French abbaye /a.be.i/ and 蓓 bèi /peɪ̯/ offer a loose auditory resemblance, but no regular historical correspondence or independent lexical-semantic match has been shown.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbaye /a.be.i/ 与“蓓”bèi /peɪ̯/ 有宽泛听感近似，但尚无规律历史对应或独立词义对应。

summary.en: The standard concept is a monastic institution/community. Spiritual cultivation as growth is a plausible interpretive frame, but the bud-to-rose transformation belongs to the literary layer.
summary.zh-Hans: 标准概念是修道机构／共同体。“灵魂修持如成长”可作解释性框架，但“蓓蕾长成玫瑰”的转换属于文学层。

summary.en: The 比, 笔 and 蓓 comparisons are retained as separately graded author observations. None is historical evidence or a replacement for 修道院.
summary.zh-Hans: “比”“笔”“蓓”的比较作为分别分级的作者观察保留；均不是历史证据，也不替代“修道院”。

claim.en: 比 bǐ is a phonetic candidate only; no supporting abbey-related lexical meaning is recorded.
claim.zh-Hans: “比”bǐ 仅为声音候选；未记录与修道院相关的支持性词义。

claim.en: 笔 bǐ is a weak/speculative observation. The proposed ‘using a pen’ interpretation lacks an independently established semantic bridge to abbey.
claim.zh-Hans: “笔”bǐ 是弱／推测性观察。“用笔”的解释缺少独立成立的语义桥梁。

claim.en: 蓓 bèi / 蓓蕾 is a literary phonetic-semantic association: an abbey imagined as a place where the soul develops like a rosebud.
claim.zh-Hans: “蓓”bèi／“蓓蕾”是文学性的声音—语义联想：把修道院想象为灵魂如玫瑰蓓蕾般成长之所。

claim.en: English abbey /ˈæbi/ ends in /bi/, while Mandarin 比 and 笔 are bǐ /pi˨˩˦/.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abbey /ˈæbi/ 以 /bi/ 结尾；普通话“比”“笔”为 bǐ /pi˨˩˦/。

limitations.en: This is a surface resemblance, not a demonstrated sound law. English /b/ and Mandarin pinyin b represent different phonetic categories, and Mandarin tone has no counterpart here.
limitations.zh-Hans: 这是表面音似，不是已证明的音变规律。英语 /b/ 与普通话拼音 b 所代表的语音范畴不同，普通话声调在此也无对应。

claim.en: French abbaye /a.be.i/, abbé /a.be/ and abbesse /a.bɛs/ share the historical abb-/ab- family; 蓓 bèi /peɪ̯˥˩/ only resembles part of these modern sounds.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abbaye /a.be.i/、abbé /a.be/、abbesse /a.bɛs/ 属于有词史关系的 abb-／ab- 词族；“蓓”bèi /peɪ̯˥˩/ 只与部分现代音形近似。

limitations.en: The relation among the French forms is historical; their resemblance to Chinese bei is not. Surface similarity must not be transferred across those two claims.
limitations.zh-Hans: 法语各形式之间有历史关系；它们与汉语 bei 的近似没有已证历史关系。不能把前一事实转移成后一结论。

semantic_structure.relation: RELIGIOUS INSTITUTION → MONASTIC COMMUNITY; literary extension: SPIRITUAL CULTIVATION → GROWTH

claim.en: The final syllable of abbey may invite a phonetic association with 比 bǐ, without a semantic or historical claim.
claim.zh-Hans: abbey 的末音节可能引发与“比”bǐ 的声音联想，但不提出语义或历史关系主张。

counterexamples: No abbey-related lexical meaning in 比
English voicing vs Mandarin aspiration contrast

testability.en: Use blinded similarity ratings with unrelated /bi, pi, bei/ controls; semantic support must be tested separately.
testability.zh-Hans: 可用盲法相似度评分，并加入无关 /bi、pi、bei/ 负对照；语义支持必须另行检验。

claim.en: 笔 bǐ may be heard as similar to abbey-final /bi/, but ‘using a pen’ does not currently supply a supported abbey meaning.
claim.zh-Hans: “笔”bǐ 在听感上可能接近 abbey 词尾 /bi/，但“用笔”目前不能提供有支持的修道院词义。

counterexamples: Many unrelated words can share /bi/-like syllables

testability.en: Require a preregistered semantic criterion and negative controls before promotion; otherwise retain as a weak observation.
testability.zh-Hans: 升级前须预先注册语义判据并设置负对照；否则只保留为弱观察。

claim.en: Abbaye/abbey and 蓓 bèi can support a literary image of an abbey as a place where the soul grows like a bud, without etymological force.
claim.zh-Hans: abbaye／abbey 与“蓓”bèi 可支持“修道院如灵魂蓓蕾成长之所”的文学意象，但不具有词源证明力。

counterexamples: 蓓蕾 is not the standard translation of abbey
Metaphorical meaning supplied by the author

testability.en: Evaluate as literary reception or mnemonic association, not as an etymological hypothesis.
testability.zh-Hans: 应作为文学接受或记忆联想评价，而不是词源假说。

proposition.en: An abbey is a place where the soul is cultivated like a bud opening toward a rose.
proposition.zh-Hans: 修道院如灵魂的蓓蕾之所，在修持中向玫瑰生长。

evidence_boundary.en: The bud, rose and spiritual-growth image is authored literature. It is searchable and preserved, but it is not lexical translation, historical etymology or independent semantic evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 蓓蕾、玫瑰与灵魂成长的意象属于作者文学创作。它可检索、被保留，但不是词义翻译、历史词源或独立语义证据。

source.raw_note: 英语：abbey ['æbi] n. 修道院。法语：abbaye n. 修道院；abbé n. 修道院院长；abbesse n. 女修道院院长。汉语候选：比 bi；笔 bi；以及文学候选‘蓓 bei／蓓蕾’。解释：这个词应该从犹太教的阿比而来。而比或许是用笔 bi 的意思。或者解释成蓓 bei、蓓蕾；这里用一个蓓蕾的蓓字对应，因为修道院是人的灵魂的修持，而生长出绚丽的玫瑰的蓓蕾的圣所。

title.zh-Hans: Abdomen · 腹部 · 肚子是我们的领地吗？

gloss.en: The part of the body between the thorax and pelvis; belly
gloss.zh-Hans: 胸部与骨盆之间的身体部位；腹部、肚子

meaning.en: 腹部/腹 is the standard formal translation; 肚子 is the standard everyday equivalent and the selected Chinese mapping. The isolated form 肚 dù is additionally preserved as an experimental phonetic-semantic candidate.
meaning.zh-Hans: “腹部／腹”是标准正式译法，“肚子”是标准日常对应词，也是本条选定的主要汉语 Mapping；单字“肚”dù 另作为实验性语音—语义候选保留。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Reviewed lexical equivalent with separate phonetic-semantic candidate

rationale.en: The ordinary lexical equivalence is strong in the BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY field. The sound comparison is independently low-confidence and does not imply common origin.
rationale.zh-Hans: 普通词义对应在 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 语义场中明确成立；声音比较另列为低置信候选，不暗示共同来源。

summary.en: English and French abdomen are learned borrowings from Latin abdōmen, with the oblique stem abdōmin-. The deeper origin of the Latin word is uncertain. Therefore ab.dom.en is not accepted as a historical segmentation. English abdominal and French abdominal/abdominale are derivatives of abdomen, not evidence for a dom root shared with dome or domain.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语和法语 abdomen 都是源自拉丁语 abdōmen 的学术借词，其斜格词干为 abdōmin-。该拉丁词更深层来源仍不确定，因此不把 ab.dom.en 接受为历史构词切分。英语 abdominal 与法语 abdominal／abdominale 是 abdomen 的派生词，不能据此推出它们与 dome 或 domain 共享 dom 词根。

claim.en: English abdomen was borrowed from Middle French and Latin; Latin abdōmen meant the belly or paunch and is of uncertain origin.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abdomen 借自中古法语与拉丁语；拉丁语 abdōmen 指腹部或大肚子，其来源不确定。

claim.en: French abdomen is a learned sixteenth-century borrowing from Latin abdomen; French abdominal is derived from French abdomen with the adjectival suffix -al.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 abdomen 是十六世纪从拉丁语 abdomen 借入的学术词；法语 abdominal 由法语 abdomen 加形容词后缀 -al 派生。

claim.en: A derivation from Latin abdere ‘hide, conceal’ has been proposed, but major dictionary treatment regards it as doubtful; no deeper decomposition is asserted here.
claim.zh-Hans: 有人提出它可能与拉丁语 abdere“隐藏”有关，但主要词典认为这一解释可疑；本记录不主张任何更深层构词切分。

claim.en: Domain, domestic, dominant and dominate belong to a house/master family through Latin domus, dominus, dominium and dominari. Architectural dome follows a Greek/late-Latin/Romance building-roof path. These histories do not derive from abdomen or from a belly sense.
claim.zh-Hans: domain、domestic、dominant、dominate 经拉丁语 domus、dominus、dominium、dominari 属于“家屋／主人”词族。建筑义 dome 则走希腊语—晚期拉丁语—罗曼语的建筑／屋顶路径。这些词史都不源自 abdomen，也不源自“肚子”义。

summary.en: abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ and 肚 dù /tu˥˩/ meet clearly in BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY meaning. Sound support is only partial: the second syllable begins with English /d/, while Mandarin pinyin d represents an unaspirated voiceless coronal stop [t]; abdomen also contains /b m n/ with no counterpart in 肚, and 肚 has lexical tone.
summary.zh-Hans: abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ 与“肚”dù /tu˥˩/ 在 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 词义上明确相交。声音支持仅属局部：abdomen 第二音节以英语 /d/ 起首，而普通话拼音 d 表示不送气清冠音 [t]；abdomen 另有 /b m n/，在“肚”中无对应，并且“肚”带词汇声调。

claim.en: The proposed domen/dom ↔ 肚 comparison reduces to a partial coronal-stop resemblance plus a strong semantic intersection; it is not the same consonant skeleton.
claim.zh-Hans: 所提 domen／dom ↔“肚”的比较可归结为局部冠音塞音近似加明确语义交点；二者并不是相同的辅音骨架。

summary.en: The authorial chain ROUND/CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL is a coherent imaginative model, not a historical derivation. The Chinese hand/control imagery is preserved as a cross-cultural cognitive note without expanding it into an origin claim.
summary.zh-Hans: 作者提出的 ROUND／CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL 是连贯的想象模型，不是历史派生链。汉语“手—支配”意象作为跨文化认知札记保留，不扩展成词源主张。

claim.en: A convex belly can be imagined through the shape of a dome and as a bodily container or personal domain.
claim.zh-Hans: 凸起的肚子可借圆顶形状来想象，也可被想象为身体容器或个人领域。

claim.en: Chinese expressions such as 手下 and the image 翻手为云，覆手为雨 associate hand imagery with subordination or control; this note is cultural-semantic, not etymological.
claim.zh-Hans: “手下”以及“翻手为云，覆手为雨”的意象把“手”与从属或支配相联；此处只作文化语义札记，不作词源解释。

summary.en: The proposed abdomen → dome → domain/control chain is retained as an authored association but rejected as a historical derivation. Similar spelling does not merge distinct etymological families.
summary.zh-Hans: 所提 abdomen → dome → domain／control 链作为作者联想保留，但作为历史派生关系不成立。拼写相似不能合并不同词源族。

claim.en: Segmenting abdomen as ab.dom.en and treating dom as the productive root is unsupported by the attested Latin form and its uncertain deeper origin.
claim.zh-Hans: 把 abdomen 切分为 ab.dom.en 并把 dom 当作能产词根，得不到已见拉丁语形式及其不确定深层来源的支持。

claim.en: Dome ‘rounded roof’, belly roundness, domain and control may form a literary-cognitive association, but the chain is not the historical source of the words.
claim.zh-Hans: dome“圆顶”、肚子的圆凸、domain 与 control 可构成文学—认知联想，但不是这些词的历史来源链。

claim.en: English abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ contains /d/ at the onset of its second syllable; Mandarin 肚 dù /tu˥˩/ begins with the pinyin d sound, phonetically an unaspirated [t].
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 abdomen /ˈæb.də.mən/ 的第二音节以 /d/ 起首；普通话“肚”dù /tu˥˩/ 以拼音 d 所记的不送气 [t] 起首。

limitations.en: The stops share coronal place but differ in voicing and phonological system. /b m n/ and Mandarin tone are unmatched, so d-m or d-m-n cannot be claimed as a shared consonantal skeleton.
limitations.zh-Hans: 两者塞音同属冠音部位，但清浊及音系不同；/b m n/ 与普通话声调均无对应，因此不能宣称共享 d-m 或 d-m-n 辅音骨架。

semantic_structure.relation: BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY; speculative association: ROUND/CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL; cross-cultural note: HAND → CONTROL

relation_to_entry.en: Direct derivative of abdomen; genuinely part of the same etymological family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: abdomen 的直接派生词；确属同一历史词族。

relation_to_entry.en: French abdomen is a learned Latin borrowing; abdominal/abdominale derives from it.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 法语 abdomen 是拉丁学术借词；abdominal／abdominale 由它派生。

relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 仅因圆凸形状与拼写产生联想；并非由 abdomen 派生。

relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 属于所有权／主人词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

relation_to_entry.en: Belongs directly to the house/home family; not to the abdomen family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 直接属于家屋／家庭词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

relation_to_entry.en: Belongs to the master/rule family; not to the abdomen family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 属于主人／统治词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

relation_to_entry.en: Belongs to the master/rule family; not to the abdomen family.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 属于主人／统治词族，不属于 abdomen 词族。

claim.en: abdomen and 肚 dù may support a limited modern-form association through a coronal stop and the shared BODY/ABDOMEN/BELLY field.
claim.zh-Hans: abdomen 与“肚”dù 可能通过冠音塞音及共享的 BODY／ABDOMEN／BELLY 语义场形成有限的现代词形联想。

testability.en: Test sound similarity and semantic fit separately with blinded ratings, unrelated body-part controls and matched non-body words.
testability.zh-Hans: 用盲法评分分别检验声音相似与语义适配，并设置无关身体部位词和匹配的非身体词作为对照。

claim.en: ROUND/CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL may function as a literary-cognitive chain even though it is not a historical word-family derivation.
claim.zh-Hans: ROUND／CONVEX → BODY CONTAINER → DOMAIN → CONTROL 可作为文学—认知链发挥作用，即使它不是历史词族派生链。

counterexamples: abdomen is not built from dome

testability.en: Evaluate as a metaphor-elicitation or literary-reception pattern, not as etymology.
testability.zh-Hans: 应作为隐喻诱发或文学接受模式评价，而不是词源假说。

text.en: Is the belly our domain? When we were children, what did the dudou over our bellies look like? We seem to have forgotten to wonder. A child's face is bright with freshness. Girls, when nature gave you the moon's gentle radiance, it did not forget to let you walk with the moon. Boys, when nature gave you sunlit faces, it did not forget to let you rise and fall with the sun.
text.zh-Hans: 肚子是我们的领地吗？当我们都是孩提时代，那在腹部上面的肚兜是啥模样？似乎都忘记想了。孩提时代的脸庞是水灵灵的。那女孩子们，大自然在给你们柔媚如月般的皎洁的时候，不忘记让你随着那月行走。那男孩子们，大自然在给你们阳光的面庞的时候，也没有忘记给你们随那太阳起落。

source.raw_note: 英语：abdomen ['æbdəmən] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；ab.dom.en；abdominal [æb'dɔminəl] a. 腹；ab.dom.inal；domain n. 领地；dome n. 圆顶，肚子就是圆形的；domestic a. 领域内的；dominant a. 主导的；dominate v. 支配。法语：ab.dom.en [abdomen] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；ab.domin.al,e [abdominal] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；abdominal (masculine)，abdominale (feminine)。汉语：肚【du】n. 肚子。备注：以上这些词汇大概都是由 dome 圆顶的根词演化而来的。也可以与肚 du 子的意思对应得上。主导等等词汇我们一般用手的词汇构成，例如手下，翻手为云覆手为雨。也许英语法语词汇用与肚子有关的词汇表达统治主导的意思。中文原文：肚子是我们的领地吗？当我们都是孩提时代，那在腹部上面的肚兜是啥模样？似乎都忘记想了。孩提时代的脸庞是水灵灵的。那女孩子们，大自然在给你们柔媚如月般的皎洁的时候。不忘记让你随着那月行走。那男孩子们，大自然在给你们阳光的面庞的时候，也没有忘记给你们随那太阳起落。用户英文原稿：Is the belly our domain? When we were children, what did the bellyband look like? I seem to have forgotten it. The face of a child is watery. Girls, when nature gave you the softness of the moon, it did not forget to let you walk with the moon. Boys, when nature gave you the sunny face, it also did not forget to let you rise and fall with the sun.

gloss.en: Departing from an accepted standard, normal course or natural type; atypical
gloss.zh-Hans: 偏离公认标准、正常路径或通常类型的；反常的、异常的

meaning.en: Aberrant is primarily an adjective, not the ordinary noun for an error. Chinese 讹 is a semantic neighbour and sound candidate, not the primary translation.
meaning.zh-Hans: aberrant 主要是形容词，并非普通名词“错误”。汉语“讹”是语义邻近项和声音候选，不是主要翻译。

rationale.en: Dictionary meaning and part of speech support 反常的／偏离常规的. The separate err ↔ 讹 comparison remains a candidate hypothesis.
rationale.zh-Hans: 词典义与词性支持“反常的／偏离常规的”；err ↔ 讹的比较另列为候选假说。

summary.en: English aberrant comes from Latin aberrant-, aberrans, the present participle of aberrare: ab- ‘away, from’ + errare ‘wander, stray, be mistaken’. French aberrant/aberrante is the adjectivized present participle of French aberrer, itself borrowed from Latin aberrare; it is not evidenced here as an English loan. French erreur continues Latin error, erroris.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 aberrant 来自拉丁语 aberrant-、aberrans，即 aberrare 的现在分词：ab-“离开、从” + errare“游荡、偏离、犯错”。法语 aberrant／aberrante 是法语 aberrer 的形容词化现在分词，而 aberrer 借自拉丁语 aberrare；没有证据支持它从英语借入。法语 erreur 承自拉丁语 error、erroris。

claim.en: English aberrant is chiefly an adjective borrowed from Latin aberrant-, aberrans, present participle of aberrare.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 aberrant 主要是形容词，借自拉丁语 aberrant-、aberrans，即 aberrare 的现在分词。

claim.en: Latin aberrare is morphologically ab- ‘away/from’ + errare ‘wander, stray, err’; the b belongs to the inherited prefix ab-.
claim.zh-Hans: 拉丁语 aberrare 的形态是 ab-“离开／从” + errare“游荡、偏离、犯错”；b 属于继承的前缀 ab-。

claim.en: French aberrant/aberrante is an adjectivized present participle of aberrer; French aberrer was borrowed from Latin aberrare.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 aberrant／aberrante 是 aberrer 的形容词化现在分词；法语 aberrer 借自拉丁语 aberrare。

claim.en: English err is a verb from Middle English erren, borrowed from Anglo-French and Latin errare; French erreur is a feminine noun from Latin error, erroris.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 err 是动词，来自中古英语 erren，经盎格鲁-法语和拉丁语 errare；法语 erreur 是阴性名词，来自拉丁语 error、erroris。

summary.en: English err and Mandarin 讹 é occupy a related error/deviation semantic field and may sound loosely similar. Their actual pronunciations are not identical: English has an r-coloured or vowel-plus-/r/ form depending on accent, while Mandarin é /ɤ˧˥/ is non-rhotic and bears lexical tone. No regular correspondence or common origin is claimed.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 err 与普通话“讹”é 同处错误／偏离语义场，也可能产生宽泛音近感。但实际发音并不相同：英语依口音具有卷舌色彩或元音加 /r/，普通话 é /ɤ˧˥/ 不卷舌且带词汇声调。这里不主张规律音变或共同来源。

claim.en: err ↔ 讹 é is a modern-form phonetic-semantic candidate: both can concern mistake/error, but sound overlap is partial and accent-dependent.
claim.zh-Hans: err ↔ 讹 é 是现代词形的语音—语义候选：两者都可涉及错误，但声音重合仅属部分且受英语口音影响。

summary.en: The historically attested motion image ‘wander away’ supports a cognitive path DEPARTURE → DEVIATION → ERROR/ABNORMALITY. This explains a shared semantic neighbourhood, not a Chinese–European etymological relation.
summary.zh-Hans: 历史可证的运动意象“游荡离开”支持 DEPARTURE → DEVIATION → ERROR／ABNORMALITY 的认知路径。这解释共享语义邻域，不证明汉语与欧洲语言的词源关系。

summary.en: The proposed idea that b was inserted merely to connect initial a to err is rejected as a historical explanation: b is part of Latin ab-. The observation is preserved as an author sound-structure hypothesis, not deleted.
summary.zh-Hans: “b 只是为连接开头 a 与 err 而加入”的想法，作为历史解释被否定：b 属于拉丁前缀 ab-。这一观察仍作为作者的声音结构假说保留，而非删除。

claim.en: Author hypothesis: b may have been inserted between a and err as a consonantal bridge.
claim.zh-Hans: 作者假说：b 可能作为辅音桥梁插入 a 与 err 之间。

claim.en: English err /er, ɜːr/ and Mandarin 讹 é /ɤ˧˥/ share an onsetless vowel-centred impression for some listeners and overlap semantically around error.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 err /er, ɜːr/ 与普通话“讹”é /ɤ˧˥/ 对部分听者有以元音为中心的近似听感，语义又都涉及错误。

limitations.en: English rhoticity, vowel quality and Mandarin lexical tone differ; ‘same sound’ overstates the comparison.
limitations.zh-Hans: 英语卷舌性、元音音质与普通话词汇声调均不同；称为“同音”会夸大比较。

claim.en: English err and Mandarin 讹 é may form a memorable modern sound-meaning association in the ERROR/DEVIATION field, without common-origin claim.
claim.zh-Hans: 英语 err 与普通话“讹”é 可能在 ERROR／DEVIATION 语义场形成可记忆的现代声音—意义联想，但不主张共同来源。

supporting_cases: err /er, ɜːr/: make a mistake; stray

testability.en: Test blinded sound-similarity and semantic-relatedness separately, with unrelated onsetless-vowel controls and multiple English accents.
testability.zh-Hans: 分别盲测声音相似度与语义相关度，加入无关零声母元音负对照，并覆盖多种英语口音。

claim.en: The b in aberrant was added as a consonantal bridge between a and err.
claim.zh-Hans: aberrant 中的 b 是在 a 与 err 之间加入的辅音桥。

supporting_cases: surface segmentation a.b.err.ant in the author note
counterexamples: French aberrer independently continues Latin aberrare

testability.en: Historical morphology is already testable against attested Latin forms and dictionary etymologies; those sources contradict the insertion account.
testability.zh-Hans: 历史形态可直接用有文献的拉丁语形式与词源词典检验；这些来源与插入说相矛盾。

proposition.en: When it is aberrant, is it beautiful like a swan, or a mis-sounded cry of a domestic goose? No—that love is full of beauty and art.
proposition.zh-Hans: 错讹的时候，是一种如天鹅般的美，还是家鹅的一声讹音？不——那爱里，仍充满美与艺。

translations.text: When it is aberrant, is it beautiful like a swan, or a mis-sounded cry of a domestic goose? No—that love is full of beauty and art.

evidence_boundary.en: The swan/domestic-goose, mis-sound, love, beauty and art wordplay is literature. It does not support the historical morphology or the err ↔ 讹 hypothesis.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 天鹅／家鹅、讹音、爱、美与艺的文字游戏属于文学，不为历史形态或 err ↔ 讹假说提供证据。
